description: Scan a project's lock file and report packages with known licence conflicts.

features.title: Resumable uploads
features.summary: Large uploads resume from the last confirmed chunk after a dropped connection.
features.author: Ama Brennan

features.title: Glob filters
features.summary: Include and exclude patterns accept shell-style globs.
features.author: Ines Varga

features.title: Config profiles
features.summary: A config file can hold named profiles for different environments.
features.author: Tomasz Okafor

features.title: Plugin hooks
features.summary: Plugins can register hooks that run before and after each file.
features.author: Olu Petrakis

deprecations.summary: The `sync_tree()` Python function is deprecated in favour of `Mirror.run()`.
The `--legacy-paths` option is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.

breaking_changes.summary: Python 3.9 is no longer supported; brindle-audit now requires Python 3.11 or later.

benchmark_notes: Benchmarks ran on the project's reference runner with the same test corpus for both versions.
The peak-memory benchmark was not rerun for this release because the runner image changed.
